scope: Independent read-only semantic review of every staged AI24 lesson and quiz, sequential prerequisite chain, beginner wording, mechanism precision and transfer. No app-file edits.
result: All24 answer keys correct and central ideas scaffolded; required small bridges/precision edits ai08 andai13 before claiming zero-assumed vocabulary. Recommended transfer/clarity refinements listed.

lessons.semantic_review: Input/output direction and fallibility explicitly taught; cat/dog transfer follows bird example.
Written-rule versus example-adjusted training distinction taught; error does not identify implementation. No language syntax assumed.
AI/ML/network/tree hierarchy defined before classification check; no claim all AI uses neural networks.
Features, labels, targets and supervised learning defined; misplaced label affects target, not photographed object. Pear specimen near-repeated but valid first application.
Train/validation/test and near-duplicate leakage explicitly explained; question supported, modest transfer rather than novel mechanism.
Generalization and overfitting defined; quiz correctly avoids diagnosing all poor performance as overfitting.
Weight/bias arithmetic defined using copies and addition; bias increment consequence correct for this explicit affine toy score.
ReLU key correct; add positive/negative meaning and qualify fixed-weight linear-layer claim. See required fixes.

needs_fix.text: A positive number is above zero. A negative number is below zero.
needs_fix.reason: The graded ReLU case uses negative two and positive three; no earlier paragraph defines signs.

needs_fix.text: If layers only multiply inputs by fixed weights and add biases, stacking them still gives one straight-line relationship. Activations such as ReLU let the network represent relationships beyond that.
needs_fix.reason: Unqualified repeated multiplication can be nonlinear (e.g., multiplying an input by itself); the limitation concerns composed affine transformations.

lessons.semantic_review: Loss and numerical distance taught through worked examples; new target10/predictions4and9 gives6and1 correctly.
Parameters, local gradient and learning-rate step size defined; no calculus test or convergence guarantee.
Forward/loss/backprop/update stages distinct; computed gradients alone do not imply applying a stored-weight update.
Batch/epoch defined; explicit simplified one-update-per-batch qualification avoids gradient-accumulation overclaim;8in2groups completes1epoch.
Token/tokenizer/identifier are explained; language model needs a short definition before first use. No named-product token trace claimed.

needs_fix.reason: Language model is first used without definition; sequence subsequently underpins attention/Transformer.
